abilities.descEn: Fixed chance of ignoring a Dark element enemy's Skill Resistance when attacking.
abilities.descZh: 攻擊時以一定機率無視闇屬性敵人的技能抗性。

abilities.descEn: Frequently avoids the effects of Ice Shot and Blizzard items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠以高機率閃避「發射冰／暴風雪」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Sometimes 1 additional Ranger is produced at no extra cost.
abilities.descZh: 以一定機率只消耗生產1隻Ranger所需的礦物量就生產出2隻Ranger。

abilities.descEn: One of that Ranger's skills will activate when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時將發動一項自己的技能。
